items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or monetization expansion; counsel_required for any upstream rights, public-display, affiliate, advertising, or notification expansion. Woot evidence confirms API access but not redistribution rights, while current public terms restrict commercial/public use. Compliance is only a technical baseline: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown, including 20 banner/consent findings and 4 privacy/terms findings. Keep SearchWoot private, leave rights outreach unsent, and permit only ordinary reversible work that adds no new data collection, permissions, credentials, dependencies, or cross-site behavior. Exact next action: attach one dated read-only evidence bundle covering rights, data flow/retention, consent and GA4, logs/vendors, and incident/request procedures. No launch clearance is supported.

Legal review of the retained allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement is conditional only after the existing repair case releases capacity and site overlap clears. Preserve existing affiliate destinations, keep the adjacent affiliate disclosure, and run build, link, smoke, disclosure, accessibility, and rollback checks. Do not add tracking, data collection, credentials, dependencies, or cross-site behavior. Do not claim revenue, ROI, margin, or causal lift.
